summary: TRACK 25 · SPRINTS 5/6 · Admin OS domain completion push — all 3 new landing pages (/admin/platform-configuration, /admin/diagnostics, /admin/maintenance) render correctly with executive verdict, complete card/section/gap/action testid coverage, evidence drawer on card click, refresh flash, back-to-AdminOS button, search + status filter row, and formatted-local-time last-refreshed stamps. /admin/platform-overview cleanly redirects to /admin (AdminOS root). OCC aggregator /api/admin/occ/health integrations drilldown correctly returns /admin/platform-configuration. Maintenance page deep-link tile storage.safe_cleanup navigates to /admin/operations-control?highlight=storage.safe_cleanup. Sprints 1-4 regression: all 6 previously-shipped domain landings load without console errors. Tablet viewport (768x1024) and desktop viewport (1920x1080) both render all 3 new pages correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: AdminOS Promise.all(probes) awaits ALL 8 probe endpoints before any card can update, so slow probes (e.g. /admin/production-certification, /admin/deploy-readiness which may 404) hold the whole grid at '…' for ~8-10s. Consider firing probes independently so each card resolves as its own endpoint returns. Not a bug — cards do settle within 10s in preview — but a UX polish for future iteration.
